does_not_prove: A vocabulary does not define an enterprise runtime or provider qualification.
supports: measurement, indication, result, uncertainty, calibration, verification and traceability are distinct metrological concepts
title: International Vocabulary of Metrology (VIM3)

does_not_prove: Calibration is not adjustment, verification or continuing validity.
supports: calibration is a two-step relation from standards and indications to measurement results under specified conditions
title: VIM 2.39 calibration

does_not_prove: Uncertainty is not error, confidence, quality or fitness by itself.
supports: uncertainty is attached to an attributed quantity value and includes stated components
title: VIM 2.26 measurement uncertainty

does_not_prove: A chain reference alone does not prove its links or applicability.
supports: a calibration hierarchy is an ordered chain and uncertainty increases along the chain
title: VIM 2.40 calibration hierarchy

does_not_prove: An instrument, certificate, laboratory name or NIST reference alone does not confer traceability.
supports: traceability is a property of a measurement result supported by an unbroken documented calibration chain and uncertainty analysis
title: Metrological traceability FAQ and policy

does_not_prove: A digital certificate schema does not prove issuer authority or measurement fitness.
supports: digital calibration reports combine calibration data and exact metadata and may derive human-readable views
title: The Digital NIST calibration-services pilot

does_not_prove: A decision rule does not grant inspection or maintenance authority.
supports: conformity decisions need an explicit rule for accounting for measurement uncertainty
title: Decision rule

does_not_prove: SI compatibility does not prove the measurand or observation binding.
supports: quantity values, numerical values, unit symbols and quantity calculus have governed meanings
title: The International System of Units

does_not_prove: An ontology mapping is not calibration or observation evidence.
supports: quantity, quantity kind, unit, dimension and datatype are distinct machine-readable concepts
title: QUDT schema

does_not_prove: O&M does not define device execution or enterprise asset identity.
supports: observation, procedure, observed property, feature of interest, sample, result and proximate/ultimate feature are separate
title: Observations, measurements and samples 3.0

does_not_prove: SensorThings transport shapes do not prove calibration, timing accuracy or asset meaning.
supports: Thing, Sensor/procedure, Datastream, Observation, ObservedProperty, FeatureOfInterest, phenomenon time and result time are explicit
title: SensorThings API Part 1 Sensing 1.1

does_not_prove: A declared process does not prove execution, qualification or result correctness.
supports: processes have unique identity, inputs, outputs, parameters, methodology, modes and constrained settings
title: SensorML 2.1

does_not_prove: A time series does not necessarily represent the ultimate feature or direct measurement.
supports: direct versus sampled observations, procedures, quality annotations and derived results must remain explicit
title: Timeseries profile of O&M

does_not_prove: An OPC information model does not establish evidential fitness.
supports: machine-vision control, configuration, recipe and result management have separate state
title: OPC UA for Machine Vision Part 1

does_not_prove: Acquisition completion is not inspection completion or acceptance.
supports: acquisition may be multi-stage, triggered and separately completed before later job results
title: Machine Vision SingleExecution state

does_not_prove: Asset discovery does not qualify a calibration artifact.
supports: calibration targets, acquisition backgrounds, environment and asset-health information are distinct resources
title: OPC UA Machine Vision Part 2

does_not_prove: A current status field does not establish metrological traceability.
supports: calibration status, date, interval, preparation time and certificate references are explicit lifecycle data
title: OPC UA for Geometric Measurement Systems

does_not_prove: Camera characterization is not geometric calibration or inspection fitness for every use.
supports: camera operating point, response model, noise, nonuniformity, sensitivity and presentation procedures affect characterization
title: EMVA 1288 Release 4.0

does_not_prove: Comparison evidence does not bind a camera to an inspection occurrence.
supports: repeatable measurement and presentation rules enable camera comparison
title: EMVA 1288 introduction

does_not_prove: Protocol presence does not prove timestamp accuracy at the acquisition point.
supports: networked measurement clocks require an explicit synchronization protocol, topology, timescale and conformance profile
title: IEEE 1588-2019
